description: The figure presents two side-by-side horizontal bar charts illustrating inference time (in minutes) for the model “Marco-o1-7B” under five methods/settings. In both panels, the category axis is vertical (y-axis) with five unlabeled rows corresponding to the legend entries, and the value axis is horizontal (x-axis) labeled “Inference Time (minute)” with a linear scale; the left panel shows ticks from 0 to about 2.5 in 0.5-minute increments, while the right panel shows ticks from 0 to about 7 in 1-minute increments. Each panel contains five single-color bars (not stacked): Baseline (light green), Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow), SFT (gray), DPO (orange), and O1-Pruner (blue). In the left panel, the bars are approximately Baseline ~2.15 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt ~2.10 minutes, SFT ~2.10 minutes, DPO ~2.10 minutes, and O1-Pruner ~1.10 minutes. In the right panel, the bars are approximately Baseline ~6.1 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt ~5.0 minutes, SFT ~5.9 minutes, DPO ~5.7 minutes, and O1-Pruner ~4.0 minutes. The bars appear arranged in a consistent top-to-bottom order matching the legend (Baseline through O1-Pruner), with no visible sorting by value and no special emphasis such as outlines or annotations.
